spans.s:
न्यृ न्य्-ऋ [cf. rt. 4. ऋ], cl. 5. P. -ऋणोति or
-ऋण्वति, &c., Ved. to put or place in; to infuse:
Caus. न्य्-अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to throw down, cast
down, overthrow.

न्यृञ्ज् न्य्-ऋञ्ज् [cf. rt. 2. ऋञ्ज्], cl. 6. A.
-ऋञ्जते, &c., Ved. to reach, attain, gain, obtain,
win; (Sāy.) to propitiate, befriend.

न्यृष् न्य्-ऋष् [cf. rt. 2. ऋष्], cl. 6. P.
-ऋषति, &c., Ved. to press down or under, suppress,
hide, cover; to put in; (Sāy.) to attain to.

न्य्-ऋष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed under; (Sāy.)
attained to, gained, endowed.
